summary: Seated on a rock beside Jacob's well, the young, haloed Christ in a purple mantle raises his hand in speech towards the Samaritan woman, who draws water with a rope from the well-head under its wooden frame. summary: In a long frieze before a classical temple, the Virgin, richly dressed like a Roman noblewoman, carries the infant Christ towards the aged Simeon, who comes forward with covered hands to receive him, accompanied by Anna, Joseph, angels and a crowd of priests. The scene unfolds in the processional, courtly manner of Late Roman imperial art. summary: Outside the walled Egyptian city of Sotinen, the governor Aphrodisius, followed by his philosophers and soldiers, comes out to greet the Holy Family; the young Christ, haloed and dressed in gold, stands at the centre between Mary and Joseph, accompanied by angels. summary: Against a deep blue sky with red-edged clouds, Christ stands at the centre on a cloud, raising his right hand in blessing and holding a scroll, while the hand of God crowns him from above.
